tasks.description: Add allowed_files field to Session dataclass with persistence and transient _warned_files counter
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Session.allowed_files persists through to_dict_for_persistence()/from_persistence(). _warned_files initializes to empty dict and is not persisted. Existing sessions without allowed_files load with None.

tasks.description: Accept and validate allowed_files in /api/v1/sessions/create endpoint
tasks.acceptance_criteria: POST /sessions/create with allowed_files=[...] stores them on Session. None and omitted are handled. Invalid entries (empty strings, non-strings) are rejected with 400.
register_session() accepts allowed_files and includes it in POST payload when non-None.

tasks.description: Add _compute_allowed_files() helper with recursive dir expansion (dir/* via fnmatch) and integrate with spawn_agent_container()
tasks.acceptance_criteria: For implement-phase coder agents with a plan_phase_id, computes union of files_affected with dir/* expansion (recursive via fnmatch) and passes to register_session(). Non-coder agents and non-implement phases get None. Empty files_affected returns None.
spawn_agent_container() accepts plan_phase_id parameter. _spawn_and_wait() passes it through. plan_phase_id is available for _compute_allowed_files() lookup.

tasks.description: Add per-task file restriction validation layer in gateway push handler with warn-then-block escalation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Push with out-of-scope file succeeds with warning on first attempt. Same file blocked on second attempt. EGG_TASK_FILE_RESTRICTIONS_ENFORCE=true blocks immediately. Checkpoint pushes bypass. Sessions without allowed_files unaffected. Error includes blocked files, allowed patterns, and recovery hint.

tasks.description: Add per-task filtering to auto_commit_worktree() alongside phase filtering
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Uncommitted files outside allowed_files are restored (not committed) with clear structured logging. Phase restrictions still apply first. None allowed_files means no per-task filtering.

tasks.description: Add Session model persistence tests for allowed_files round-trip, backward compat, and _warned_files transient init
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests verify allowed_files round-trips through to_dict_for_persistence()/from_persistence(). Sessions without allowed_files key load with None. _warned_files initializes to empty dict and is not present in persisted output.

tasks.description: Add gateway tests for per-session file restriction enforcement (push validation) including recursive fnmatch verification
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests cover allowed files pass, disallowed warns then blocks, strict mode, checkpoint bypass, None/empty fallback, glob patterns, directory-sibling expansion, and explicit recursive matching (dir/* covers dir/sub/deep/file.py). All pass.

tasks.description: Add tests for post-agent commit filtering with allowed_files
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests cover files outside allowed_files are restored, files inside are committed, None means no filtering, logging verifies filtered files reported.

tasks.description: Add orchestrator tests for _compute_allowed_files() and spawner integration
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests cover union of files from multiple tasks, dir-sibling expansion (recursive via fnmatch), empty returns None, non-coder returns None, non-implement returns None, glob preservation, register_session called with computed allowed_files.

tasks.description: Update plan template to document files as enforcement boundary with guidance on generous listing and recursive directory expansion
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Template states files is enforced at push time. Includes guidance on generous listing, globs, config files. Documents that directory expansion is recursive (dir/* matches all descendants via fnmatch). Empty files means no restriction.
